newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand says to help Cambodia capture Pol Pot.
newsitem.headline: Thailand says to help Cambodia capture Pol Pot.

text.p: Thailand will help Cambodia capture renegade Khmer Rouge leader Pol Pot who is said to have killed his defence chief and fled his base, a senior Thai general said on Friday.

"The immediate task for the Cambodian troops is to rescue Khieu Samphan and later join hands in crushing the remaining Khmer Rouge guerrillas led by the hardliner Pol Pot," the general who deals with the Cambodian conflict told Reuters.
Thai troops will seal off the northern Thai-Cambodian border and cooperate with the Cambodian government to capture Pol Pot, he said.

"Pol Pot would have nowhere to go but to die in Cambodia," the general said, adding that Pol Pot's actions in killing his defence minister Son Sen and abducting nominal leader Khieu Samphan were unforgivable acts.
Cambodian co-premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh said that he had reports that Pol Pot was fleeing his Anlong Veng northern base with about 200 loyalists and Khieu Samphan as hostage.
He also said he had photographs to prove Son Sen's murder and that most of the Khmer Rouge guerrillas had now defected to the Cambodian government side.
